cards.name: VR Spherical Blur
cards.summary: Blurs the outgoing 360/VR clip with a seam-aware spherical blur, crossfades at peak blur and sharpens into the incoming clip. Made for equirectangular footage.
use_for: soft location or time change in immersive documentary segments
blur-through between two VR explainer scenes
avoid: on flat 16:9 footage it renders concentric swirl/ring artefacts (seen in the gallery render): use Blur Dissolve instead
heavier to render than flat blur transitions
cards.equivalent: AE: VR Blur (Immersive Video) keyframed up on A to the cut and down on B with an opacity crossfade at the peak; for flat footage Gaussian Blur + opacity crossfade.
cards.scripting: Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 321.52-322.52 s on the cut at 322.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Single-sided use (blur in from / out to black) assumed, not tested.

verified.note: A blurs into concentric spherical swirl rings at the cut and B sharpens out of them, matching the flat-footage ring artefact the card describes.

cards.name: Whip (Legacy)
cards.summary: Old native GPU whip: the incoming clip pushes the outgoing one off horizontally under heavy directional motion blur, like a fast whip-pan. Superseded by the new 'Whip' (Film Impact based).
use_for: whip-pan cut between two locations in a reel
avoid: use the current 'Whip' (Slide folder) for new edits
fewer controls than the new Whip (which adds speed curves and chromatic aberration), so the move can look dated
cards.equivalent: Replacement in Premiere: 'Whip' (Slide folder, Film Impact AE.Impact_Whip). AE: animate Position of A out and B in over 6-10 frames with layer Motion Blur (shutter 360) or Directional Blur (direction 90 deg) keyframed to peak at the cut.
cards.scripting: Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 325.52-326.52 s on the cut at 326.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render: horizontal blur streak with both images sliding sideways. Folder 'Slide' is from memory of older Premiere versions (not verified in 2026).

verified.note: Heavy horizontal motion-blur streaks smear A off and B on, a clear fast whip-pan.

cards.name: Louver
cards.summary: Turns the outgoing clip into angled 3D venetian-blind slats that rotate with perspective and motion blur to reveal the next shot.
use_for: section or chapter change in explainers
reveal of a new location or b-roll in reels
reveal of a title or stat card
avoid: black shows between the slats mid-turn; on a dark-to-dark cut it reads as a flicker
too decorative for sombre documentary moments
cards.equivalent: AE: Card Wipe (Rows 1, Columns 10-16, Flip Axis Y, Back Layer = incoming clip, Transition Completion 0->100%) with camera tilt for the angled look; Venetian Blinds for a flat version.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_3D_Blinds; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 329.52-330.52 s on the cut at 330.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render: slanted slats with black gaps, B visible through the slats after the cut.

verified.note: Angled slats with black gaps alternate A and B strips with perspective, exactly the venetian-blind look.

cards.name: Block Motion
cards.summary: 3D block animation: the frame moves like a solid block or cube that rotates and dollies with perspective and motion blur to bring in the next shot. It is also made to animate graphic layers in and out.
use_for: animating a lower third or stat card in/out over footage
explainer scene change with a motion-graphics feel
avoid: in the 1 s default gallery render the whole move happened in the first ~3 frames and B then held still, so check timing/curve settings or keep it short
too playful for serious news
cards.equivalent: AE: precompose each clip, make it 3D and rotate X or Y 90 deg about an anchor on the block edge (cube turn), add a camera dolly and Motion Blur; a simpler version is Transform effect rotation/position keyframes with shutter angle 180-360.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_3D_Block; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 333.52-334.52 s on the cut at 334.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Catalog content type fullScreen|motionGraphics, so single-sided on a graphic layer animates it in or out.

verified.note: At -0.3 s B is already in on a tilted perspective block with black above it and is nearly settled by the cut, a quick 3D block move as the card (and its timing caveat) says.

cards.name: Flip Motion
cards.summary: Flips the picture over like a 3D plane with perspective, a dolly, an easing curve and motion blur, revealing the incoming shot on the back (catalog: flip-over clock style). At defaults the gallery render turned around the vertical axis. It can also flip graphics in or out.
use_for: flip to a new number or stat card
before/after flip between two shots in reels
turning to the next chapter in explainers
animating graphic cards in or out
avoid: black shows around the tilted plane mid-flip unless something sits on the track below
too playful for sombre or obituary content
cards.equivalent: AE: 3D layers with a camera; Y Rotation 0->90 on A then -90->0 on B with easy ease and Motion Blur (or Card Wipe 1x1 with Flip).
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_3D_Flip; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 337.52-338.52 s on the cut at 338.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render: A tilts away in perspective on black, B lands with slight skew and blur.

verified.note: A turns on a perspective plane around the vertical axis over black, then B lands with horizontal motion blur, a flip-over as described.

cards.name: 3D Roll
cards.summary: A 3D take on the roll transition: the image rolls around a curved, bulged surface with perspective and strong motion blur, carrying the next shot in from the side.
use_for: trailer montage beats on the music
avoid: heavy blur hides the picture for most of the transition; keep it short
frequent use feels like a template edit
cards.equivalent: AE: Offset (Shift Center To keyframed) or a Position move with Directional Blur, plus Optics Compensation / CC Cylinder for the bulge; or a 3D precomp on CC Cylinder rotating with Motion Blur.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_3D_Roll; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 341.52-342.52 s on the cut at 342.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render: horizontal streaked roll, B entering from the left. Single-sided rolls in over black or the track below (assumed, not tested).

verified.note: Both shots share the frame in a fast horizontal roll smeared by strong motion blur with B coming from the left; the bulge is hard to see at this size.

cards.name: 3D Spin
cards.summary: The outgoing shot twirls away into depth, shrinking to a small spinning card over black, then the incoming shot spins back toward camera to full frame with zoom blur.
use_for: playful topic switch in AI-education reels
intro into a title or logo reveal
avoid: frame is almost all black mid-transition with a tiny picture: reads cheap/2000s in documentaries
faces become tiny and unreadable
cards.equivalent: AE: 3D layers with a camera; Z Rotation + Scale/Z Position out on A and in on B, Motion Blur on, plus CC Radial Fast Blur or Radial Blur (Zoom).
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_3D_Rotate; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 345.52-346.52 s on the cut at 346.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render confirmed the shrink-spin-to-black then spin-in.

verified.note: A twirls away into a tiny spinning card over black at the cut and B spins back toward camera with zoom blur.

cards.name: Additive Dissolve
cards.summary: Additive dissolve: the two images' light is added, so the mix blooms brighter mid-way before settling on the incoming shot. Has curve and gamma controls. Replaces Additive Dissolve (Legacy).
use_for: music-driven reel montage on bright footage
transition into a bright or sunlit scene
avoid: bright footage clips to white at the midpoint
on dark-to-dark cuts the bloom is weak and it reads close to a plain cross dissolve
cards.equivalent: AE: overlap A and B, put B on top in Add blend mode; first half B opacity 0->100% with A held at 100% (the sum blooms), second half A opacity 100->0%.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.Impact_Additive_Dissolve; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 349.52-350.52 s on the cut at 350.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point.

verified.note: The midpoint mix of A and B is visibly brighter and washed out, the additive bloom described.

cards.name: Blur Dissolve
cards.summary: Blurs the outgoing shot while crossfading into the incoming one, which comes back into focus. Optional chromatic aberration.
use_for: blur into a title or graphic
avoid: too soft for hard news cuts
long durations look like a focus mistake
cards.equivalent: AE: Gaussian Blur or Camera Lens Blur keyframed up on A to the cut and down on B, with an opacity crossfade.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_Blur_dissolve; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 353.52-354.52 s on the cut at 354.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point.

verified.note: At the cut the picture is a heavy defocus blur dissolving A into B, then B is sharp again.

cards.name: Burn Alpha
cards.summary: Luma-driven burn dissolve: the outgoing shot burns away through its darker tones (dark blotches spread, near black at the midpoint) and the incoming shot burns in from the shadows. Colourise options.
use_for: dark or tense political explainer beat
avoid: goes near-black mid-transition, so on dark footage it reads as a dip to black
dark faces and clothing burn first
cards.equivalent: AE: CC Burn Film on A keyframed up to the cut and down on B; or Gradient Wipe on A (Gradient Layer = A itself, Softness 30-50%) over a black solid to the cut, then the same on B with Invert Gradient, completion 100->0%. Plain Gradient Wipe over B would reveal B instead of burning to black.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_Burn_Alpha; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 357.52-358.52 s on the cut at 358.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render: black burn blotches spread over A, almost fully dark at the cut.

verified.note: A burns away through dark blotches to a near-black midpoint before B appears, a dark luma burn.

cards.name: Burn Chroma
cards.summary: Bright burn: the outgoing shot's highlights flare into an overexposed white (optionally colourised) burn that spreads and then reveals the incoming shot, like a film burn to light.
use_for: energetic music-video style cut in reels
transition into a bright celebration or rally shot
avoid: blows out text and faces mid-transition
too flashy for sober news
cards.equivalent: AE: Gradient Wipe driven by A's inverted luminance plus Exposure/Glow keyframed up around the cut; or a film-burn / light-leak overlay in Screen or Add mode over an opacity crossfade.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_Burn_White; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render: white bleached blobs spreading, B showing through.

verified.note: The mix at the cut has blown-out white burn patches spreading from the highlights over both shots.

cards.name: Travel Motion
cards.summary: Travel/push animation: the outgoing shot travels out of frame and the incoming one travels in, with an adjustable angle, an easing (speed) curve and motion blur. At defaults the gallery render moved vertically (A up and out, B up from below). Also used to animate graphics in or out.
use_for: animating titles or cards in/out over footage
avoid: at default (1 s) the gallery showed a short black gap of 2-3 frames between A leaving and B arriving: put a background on the track below or shorten it
bouncy feel is wrong for sombre content
cards.equivalent: AE: Position keyframes with strong ease (or the Transform effect), A straight up and out of frame then B up in from below, layer Motion Blur on.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_C-Push; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 365.52-366.52 s on the cut at 366.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render at defaults: A shot up out of frame, B rose from below with vertical blur.

verified.note: A is shifted up out of frame with black below at -0.3 s and B rises from below at +0.3 s; the cut frame itself is fully black, the gap the card already warns about.

cards.name: Chaos
cards.summary: Camera-shake transition: both clips jitter in hard position jumps (about 10-30 px at 1080p, alternating horizontal and vertical, each held 2 frames) with a light blur, around a short ~0.2 s 50/50 mix on the cut. At defaults on a 1 s transition the shake runs from ~0.45 s before the cut to ~0.55 s after; frame edges stay filled. The catalog also lists noise distortion and chromatic aberration, but no colour split or warp showed in the default render.
use_for: hard energetic cut on a beat drop in reels
shock or reveal moment in a political explainer
avoid: a single still looks like a plain dissolve; the shake only reads in playback, so judge it on the moving render
no RGB split or noise warp at defaults (the batch exposes no properties): add those separately if wanted
overuse makes an edit feel frantic
cards.equivalent: AE: on the A/B overlap, Transform effect with Position = posterize-time 12.5 fps wiggle of ~25 px plus a light Directional/Gaussian Blur on both clips, and a ~0.2 s opacity crossfade centred on the cut; add Shift Channels or offset RGB copies for the catalog's colour split.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_Chaos; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 369.52-370.52 s on the cut at 370.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Measured at defaults (phase correlation against the clean sources, Cross Dissolve as control at 0 px): A shakes from -0.44 s, the mix runs -0.08 to +0.12 s, B shakes until +0.52 s and is clean from +0.56 s; peak offset 31 px, sharpness down to ~0.6x, R/B channel offset 0.

verified.note: Frame-by-frame scan of the render shows a real camera shake: A and B are offset 11-31 px (1080p) in alternating directions for ~1 s with mild blur, around a ~0.2 s mid-point mix; 092b catches only the mix, so the shake is invisible in the still. No colour split (R/B offset 0) or noise warp.
verified.second_opinion: corrected: first verifier said no visible shake and a slight zoom on B; measurement shows an 11-31 px shake on both clips from -0.44 s to +0.52 s (no zoom, translation only) with light blur, so the shake is the effect at defaults. Summary/look/avoid/scripting rewritten to the measured look, chromatic aberration and noise warp dropped from look, verdict weak -> pass, confidence low -> medium.

cards.name: Clock Wipe
cards.summary: Radial clock-hand wipe: the incoming shot is revealed by a hand sweeping clockwise from 12 o'clock around the centre (hard edge at defaults). Adds repeats, mirroring and curve controls. Replaces Clock Wipe (Legacy).
avoid: looks cheesy and 2000s on ordinary cuts
the moving edge slices through faces
cards.equivalent: AE: Radial Wipe on A (Start Angle 0, Wipe Clockwise, Feather 0 for the default hard edge, Transition Completion 0->100%) over B.
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_Clock_Wipe; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Gallery render: clockwise sweep from 12 o'clock, B in the top-right quadrant first.

verified.note: A hard-edged radial hand sweeps clockwise from 12: B fills the top-right quadrant at -0.3 s, the right half at the cut and nearly all of the frame at +0.3 s.

cards.name: Cross Dissolve
cards.summary: Standard crossfade from one shot into the next, rebuilt with curve and gamma-correction controls for a cleaner midpoint. Replaces Cross Dissolve (Legacy).
use_for: soft time or location change in documentary
fade in/out at sequence start or end (single-sided)
avoid: slow and amateur on fast reels; prefer hard cuts
mismatched exposure makes a muddy midpoint (use the gamma control)
cards.equivalent: AE: overlap the layers and keyframe opacity of the upper (incoming) layer 0->100% (fade A out as well for a true crossfade on transparent backgrounds).
cards.scripting: Built-in 2026 Film Impact transition (Film Impact catalog match name AE.AE_Impact_Dissolve; the batch has no match name, so match is null). Placed OK by QE addTransition at 1 s centred: 381.52-382.52 s on the cut at 382.0 s (starts 0.48 s before the cut, ends 0.52 s after, about half a frame late of exact centre at 25 fps). Centred needs handles on both clips: outgoing media >= dur/2 past its out point, incoming >= dur/2 before its in point. Not verified whether the sequence default transition (Ctrl+D) uses this or Cross Dissolve (Legacy); apply by exact name.

verified.note: A clean even crossfade of A and B at the midpoint with no other effect.
